chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari narrated to me from Abi Sa'id Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Zakariyya Al-'Adwi Al-Basri, who said: 'Abd al-A'la ibn Hammad Al-Bursi narrated to us, Wahb narrated to us from 'Abdillah ibn 'Uthman from Sa'id ibn Abi Rashid from Ya'la Al-'Amiri, who said: I left the presence of the Messenger of Allah (s.a.a.w.) to go to a meal to which I had been invited.

He found Al-Husayn (a.s.) playing with the children. The Prophet (s.a.a.w.) faced him in front of the people, then spread his arms. The boy ran here and there, and the Messenger of Allah (s.a.a.w.) amused him until he caught him. He placed one hand under his chin and the other behind his neck, placed his mouth on his mouth, and kissed him.
Then he said: 'Al-Husayn is from me and I am from Al-Husayn. Allah loves those who love Al-Husayn. Al-Husayn is a chief (sibt) from among the chiefs.'

key_terms.حُسَيْنٌ: Al-Husayn, the grandson of the Prophet
key_terms.سِبْطٌ: A chief or noble descendant, often used for the Imams

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about his love for Al-Husayn and the reward for loving him?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the Prophet’s public affection for Imam Husayn (a.s.), establishing the concept of *al-Sibt* (the pure descendant) as a title of honor and spiritual lineage. It reinforces the Shia doctrine of *Mawadda* (affection), linking the love for the Ahl al-Bayt directly to divine love, a theme central to the verse of purification and the verse of kinship.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 12. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from Abī Sa’īd Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Zakariyyā Al-‘Adwi Al-Basri, from ‘Abdil A’lā ibn Ḥammād Al-Bursi, from Wahab, from ‘Abdillāh ibn ‘Uthmān, from Sa’īd ibn Abī Rāshid, from Ya’lā Al-‘Āmiri, who said: I was going with the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) to a place where he was invited for food when we saw Ḥusain (a.s.) playing with (other) children.

The Prophet (s.a.a.w.) went ahead of us and opened his arms (to catch him). Ḥusain (a.s.) was running in different directions and the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) was making him laugh until he caught him. Then he placed one of his hands under Ḥusain’s chin and the other hand behind his head. He placed his mouth on the mouth of Ḥusain (a.s.) and kissed him.
Then he said, “Ḥusain (a.s.) is from me and I am from Ḥusain (a.s.). Allāh loves those who love Ḥusain (a.s.). Ḥusain (a.s.) is a chief from among the chiefs.”
